title: select-method-documentlink-multilingual-support.html
content: How It Works The following logic describes how the Data Dictionary Group/Data Dictionary Entry records interact with the {{variable.Field_DataDict_DisplayLanguage}} field. DocumentLink labels are displayed in English, the default language, when either of the following is true. The DocumentLink Template’s {{variable.Field_DataDict_DisplayLanguage}} and {{variable.Field_DataDict_DataDictionaGrp}} fields are blank. The {{variable.Field_DataDict_DisplayLanguage}} field is blank, and the {{variable.Field_DataDict_DataDictionaGrp}} does not have a Data Dictionary Entry for the English language. DocumentLink labels are displayed in the values given for the selected language in the {{variable.Field_DataDict_DataDictionaGrp}} if the Data Dictionary Group has a Data Dictionary Entry record for the DocumentLink Template’s {{variable.Field_DataDict_DisplayLanguage}} . DocumentLink labels are displayed in the DocumentLink Template’s {{variable.Field_DataDict_DisplayLanguage}} if the related Data Dictionary Group does not include a Data Dictionary Entry record for the selected {{variable.Field_DataDict_DisplayLanguage}} . DocumentLink labels are displayed in the values given for the English language in the Data Dictionary Group if the Data Dictionary Group includes a Data Dictionary Entry record for the English language, and the DocumentLink Template’s {{variable.Field_DataDict_DisplayLanguage}} field is blank. When the {{variable.Field_DataDict_DataDictionaGrp}} field is blank, DocumentLink labels are displayed in the selected DocumentLink Template’s {{variable.Field_DataDict_DisplayLanguage}} . Data Dictionary Required Licenses and Permission Sets To use the Data Dictionary feature, you must have a Blackthorn Payments license, as well as access to the following fields: Create/Read/Update - Data Dictionary Group Create/Read/Update - Data Dictionary Entry Supported Languages We do not currently support all languages. The following is a list of the languages we support. Arabic Chinese (Simplified) Chinese (Traditional) Czech Danish Dutch Finnish French German Haitian Creole Hindi Hmong Hungarian Indonesian Italian Japanese Korean Norwegian Polish Portuguese Romanian Russian Somali Spanish Swedish Thai Turkish Vietnamese One-to-One Relationships A Data Dictionary Entry record contains three important fields: {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} , {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} , and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} . In each Data Dictionary Entry record, the fields interact as follows: There can be only one value in the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} field. Each {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} is associated only with one {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} . Creating a second line in the Data Dictionary Entry using the same {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} as the first line but with a different {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} will replace the first {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} with the new one. Example: Line 1: {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_CHECKOUT" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "Checkout" Line 2: {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_CHECKOUT" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = “Proceed” Result: The Attendee will see “Proceed.” Create a Data Dictionary Group If you want to override out-of-the-box values, the first step is to create a Data Dictionary Group and populate it with Data Dictionary Entries. In the App Launcher, enter and click “Data Dictionary Group”. Click {{variable.button_new}} .   Enter a {{variable.Field_DataDict_DataDictGrpName}} . Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .   Click {{variable.button_new}} next to Data Dictionary Entry.   The {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_DataDictValu}} field contains the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} , {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} , and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} . Click the DocumentLink Data Dictionary (a Google document) for {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} information. Here are a few frequently used Data Dictionary values and their keys: {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_CHECKOUT" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "Checkout" {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_INVOICE" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "Invoice" {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "LBL_BALANCE_PAID" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "Balance Paid" {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "MSG_PROCESSING_TRANSACTION" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "Processing transaction…" {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = "MSG_AUTHORIZE_CREDIT_CARD_WITH_NAME" and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = "I authorize [XYZ] to charge my credit card." Select the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} you'd like to change. Enter a {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} . Click Back to return to the Data Dictionary Group record.   If you need to add additional keys to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}} , click the menu (upside down triangle) next to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryEntry}} . From there, click Add Row to add a new {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} . When you are done, click {{variable.Button_Save}} and Back to return to the {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} . USE CAPITAL LETTERS In the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} field, use capital letters. Example In this example, we will set {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_LanguageLoca}} = "German". Now, we can select any word or phrase to replace an action with. Set {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} = “LBL_DUE_DATE“ and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} = “Faelligkeitsdatum”. Make sure to use all capital letters for the {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} . Add a Data Dictionary Group to a DocumentLink Template Open an existing DocumentLink Template or create a new one. Click the {{variable.Button_Pencil}} icon next to the {{variable.Field_DataDict_DataDictionaGrp}} field. Select a {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} . Click {{variable.Button_Save}} . Default Languages Change the Default Language The following functionality has been added. DocumentLink checkout will be displayed in the language selected on the {{variable.Object_DocumentLinkTemplate}} record. Labels will default to English if the {{variable.Field_DocLinkTemp_DisplayLangu}} field on the {{variable.Object_DocumentLinkTemplate}} record is left blank. The language on labels and buttons can be overwritten with a {{variable.Object_DataDictionaryGroup}} record containing the matching {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Key}} and {{variable.Field_DataDictEnt_Value}} . The date will be formatted based on the language selected on the {{variable.Object_DocumentLinkTemplate}} . If no language is selected, the date format will be based on the browser’s location. Translate a DocumentLink Template Go to an {{variable.Object_Invoice}} record. Click an existing {{variable.Field_Invoice_DocumentLinkTemp}} or create a new one. Select a {{variable.Field_DocLinkTemp_DisplayLangu}} .   Click {{variable.Button_Save}} .
